parameters.name: options
parameters.description: - The initial value of the dark mode, default `false`.

properties.name: defaultValue
properties.description: The initial value of the dark mode.

properties.name: localStorageKey
properties.description: The key to use in the local storage.

properties.name: initializeWithValue
properties.description:
If `true` (default), the hook will initialize reading `localStorage`.
In SSR, you should set it to `false`, returning the `defaultValue` or `false` initially.

returnType.name: DarkModeReturn
returnType.description: An object containing the dark mode's state and its controllers.

properties.name: isDarkMode
properties.description: The current state of the dark mode.

properties.name: toggle
properties.description: Function to toggle the dark mode.

properties.name: enable
properties.description: Function to enable the dark mode.

properties.name: disable
properties.description: Function to disable the dark mode.

properties.name: set
properties.description: Function to set a specific value to the dark mode.
